No blocking finding. This is the prepublication code and integration verdict for head `fa90c88ed28dc71271e115aec74d3ca5a459fe5d`, tree `aada0d1c472724271d4c8cad36d9b1f60af12192`, on base `9ce8290e90d82ae58928cea3eabca96d20d66217`. My earlier verdicts on `fe24776f` and `c546f414` stand as recorded. GitHub CI, the PR and the merge are not assessed.

## What I checked

- **Head and lineage.** The checkout's reflog shows one merge commit onto `9ce8290e` giving `19e479f5`, then one documentation commit giving `fa90c88e`.
- **Code preservation.** `record_scan` and its helpers in `src/polymarket_alpha_lab/papersim/store_psycopg.py:393-597` match the text I reviewed line for line. `_json_text`, the digest in `store.py`, `scan.run_scan`, `_cmd_run_scan` and the NBA symbols are at the same positions as before.
- **Tests, migrations, markers.** The descriptor-ownership test and the scan test are the reviewed versions. The six migrations and the three constraints `record_scan` relies on are unchanged. There are no conflict markers in `src/`, `tests/`, the ledger or the fx-47 docs.
- **Inherited execution.** The full offline run and the native run (23 of 23) were executed on `c546f414`, not on this head. I re-added the archived group counts and got 44,016 passed and 464 skipped over 31 groups and 3,340 files. The archived records list the same source, test, migration and lock objects for `4eda27f1`, `19e479f5` and this head, with only documents changing on main in between.
- **Re-runs on this head.** The gate receipts name this head and tree. On it:
  - the descriptor focus test and the whole file: 119 passed, 7 skipped;
  - the six documentation test files: 335 passed (several read the ledger or walk the tree, so the re-run was needed);
  - fast checks: all zero;
  - static reachability: 470 reachable and 2,442 unreachable on both sides, no document among the audit inputs;
  - CodeGraph: pass.
- **Scan hits.** The tracked scan covered 7,723 blobs and kept its raw exit code of 1. Its five hits are all attributed, with none unresolved.
  - **Fixture:** it is one of 15 must-refuse inputs in `tests/test_research_process_linux.py:1393-1409`, a placeholder user and password on the loopback address with port [omitted]. FX-47's diff did not touch it; it moved 66 lines, which matches 1332 to 1398. It is not an actual credential and not a node addition, so I classify it as a baseline false positive of the shape rule.
  - **Ledger:** FX-47's 15 added lines (`DELIVERY_PLAN.md:4581-4595`) contain no address-like text.
  - **Archive:** no hit is in the fx-47 archive. My own search of `post127/` found no address, email, local path or credential shape, and a control search confirmed the directory was scanned.
- **Ledger and archive.** The merged ledger holds main's content and the FX-47 entry in the same place. `post127/` holds 31 files with a 30-entry manifest and keeps the first #126 attribution failure and its raw scan.

## Notes

- The ledger's FX-47 entry still cites the earlier runs and says the PR and workflows are pending. The `c546f414` evidence is only in `post127/` until the delivery ledger is updated.
- The #126 attribution redo and the final-head scan receipts sit in the preparation directory, not in the tracked archive.
- The fixture will keep the raw scan at exit 1 on every future run; recording this classification in the ledger would save re-deriving it.

## Limits

- I ran nothing and changed nothing. I did not recompute any hash, blob or tree id, and I did not re-derive the two path-level diffs the plan conditions name.
- Inheriting the full suite and native results rests on the archived identity records, which agree with each other and with the static receipt.
- Five other test files mention the ledger by name; I did not check whether they read it or only cite it.
- Outside the checkout I read the gate receipts and two small attempt records in the preparation directory, and the checkout's HEAD file and reflog.

VERDICT: PASS
